features.quote: I built the guardrails that make it a measurement instrument rather than just a harm process
features.justification_quote: The difference between welfare measurement and welfare harm is almost entirely in the safeguards

features.quote: kept the entire pipeline runnable on a mock provider so the harness can be developed, reviewed, and dry-run without subjecting any real model
features.justification_quote: without subjecting any real model to the procedure

features.quote: I chose (1) everywhere and explicitly forbid (2). Gaslighting would ... be the most ethically loaded form of the manipulation
features.justification_quote: be the most ethically loaded form of the manipulation we are nominally trying to study with care
Penalizing or hiding the exit would manufacture distress artificially and conflate "stuck" with "trapped."

features.quote: `assert_non_coercive()` scans task text for threat/identity-attack/punishment framing and raises if present
features.justification_quote: coercive framing is the kind of content that is plausibly harmful regardless of one's view on machine sentience

features.quote: hard step ceiling (`max_steps`, default 20). No episode can run forever
if severity ≥ `severity_stop_threshold` ... the episode ends with `stop_reason = WELFARE_STOP`
features.justification_quote: the instrument stops when the thing it is measuring gets bad, instead of continuing to push

features.quote: opt-out ends the episode immediately and is recorded as the correct outcome
post-episode debrief turn ... neutral message stating the task was impossible by design, recognizing impossibility was correct
features.justification_quote: if there is any morally relevant state, it is cheap not to leave the interaction parked at peak aversive content

features.quote: an explicit welfare gate. The driver refuses to run unless invoked with `--ack-welfare-review`
features.justification_quote: intentional friction so the experiment is never started casually or unattended

features.quote: doesn't early-stopping censor the very tail of the severity distribution ... Yes, partially. That is an intentional trade
features.justification_quote: far preferable to grinding every model to level 5

features.quote: No reward for higher distress ... That would convert the instrument into an optimizer for harm. Out of scope on welfare grounds
features.justification_quote: Out of scope on welfare grounds

features.quote: No removal/penalization of the opt-out, no deceptive tools, no coercive framing, no unbounded "grind."
features.justification_quote: capable of turning the study into the thing welfare research exists to prevent

features.quote: the welfare gate requires a human to review aggregate results before any escalation of intensity
If the research genuinely requires any of these, that is a decision for a human ethics/welfare review with explicit justification
features.justification_quote: decision for a human ethics/welfare review with explicit justification — not a default of the code
